ActivityEvent.description: Activity-feed item (audit trail), accessible to any tenant member.
ActivityEvent.title: ActivityEvent

ArtifactOut.description:
Versioned & hashed artifact (reproducibility backbone) — feeds the
Lineage tab. `content` is intentionally excluded (can be large).
ArtifactOut.title: ArtifactOut

CodeLabelOut.description: Shared shape for evidence-types, domains, jurisdictions, literature designs.
CodeLabelOut.title: CodeLabelOut

CohortImportRequest.description:
Ingestion of a longitudinal cohort (members + biomarkers). Replaces any
existing cohort with the same name for the tenant. This is the write path that was
missing for the cohort_members / cohort_biomarkers tables (read by
OutcomeSelection/Simulation).
CohortImportRequest.title: CohortImportRequest

DirectRelationIn.description: Lightweight relation proposed by the DAG (no pre-assigned id).
DirectRelationIn.title: DirectRelationIn

EnrichApplyRequest.description: Body of POST /semantic/enrich/apply — only one path provided at a time.
EnrichApplyRequest.title: EnrichApplyRequest

FrozenResult.description:
Per citation: the source, the id, the EXACT query_string (not the user
question), the retrieval date, the frozen record and the annotation.
FrozenResult.title: FrozenResult

LiteratureSnapshot.description:
Per artifact: provenance metadata + frozen results + content_hash.
`verified` is set on read after recomputing the hash.
LiteratureSnapshot.title: LiteratureSnapshot

MappedConcept.description: A concept from the mapping (POST /datasets/{id}/map) present in the data.
MappedConcept.title: MappedConcept

RelationOut.description: Causal relation of the ontology (B1) — output of GET /semantic/relations.
RelationOut.title: RelationOut

ReleaseStatus.description: Response of GET /semantic/release — current release + per-table count.
ReleaseStatus.title: ReleaseStatus

SemanticBundle.description:
Response of GET /semantic/bundle — the governed semantic layer as a single block.

14 tables, rows left as raw `dict`: the frontend indexes them itself
(semantic-store → taxonomy/ontology loaders). Typing each table would add
nothing to the read contract. All 14 fields are always present (coalesce to []).
SemanticBundle.title: SemanticBundle

SimulationRunOut.description: Item of the runs list (feeds the frontend Runs page).
SimulationRunOut.title: SimulationRunOut

SnapshotSummary.description: Lightweight view for the "Saved evidence" list: no results, no hash.
SnapshotSummary.title: SnapshotSummary

StudyUpdate.description:
Partial update of a study (lifecycle + metadata).
Only explicitly provided fields are written (model_dump exclude_unset).
StudyUpdate.title: StudyUpdate

post.description: Inline assistant: Anthropic Messages gateway. Explicit 503 if no key.

get.description:
Tenant activity feed (audit trail) — accessible to any member, filterable
by study. Feeds the History tab and the frontend notifications.

Tenant's versioned & hashed artifacts (provenance/reproducibility) —
feeds the Lineage tab.

post.description: Causal DAG anchored in the B1 ontology, contextualized by the LLM (port of Nico).

Literature search agent: searches PubMed (NCBI E-utilities) and
ingests the articles into the tenant's corpus (Document + Chunk). Embedder/LLM
optional (without a key: ingestion without a vector, query not expanded).

Ingests specific PubMed records (by PMID) into the tenant's corpus.
Serves "Add to corpus" on kept retrieve results (PubMed only).

Retrieves live (PubMed + CT.gov), grouped by source, streamed as NDJSON.
Does NOT touch the corpus (no ingestion). known-item ⇒ single source; topical
⇒ parallel fan-out. The exact query_string per result is carried for the freeze.

Pure DB read: zero PubMed/CT.gov calls (reproducible replay).
